payload.text: Issue 0650, S by vc's read, next after 0661 (vc's order of 2026-11-10 09:09Z): the upgrade that writes the tracked .githooks/ dispatchers also keeps a marked `.githooks/ export-ignore` block in the project's .gitattributes, doctor names a project that tracks .githooks/ without it, and one test reads git archive after an upgrade in a fresh repository. Intent's own .gitattributes takes the block in the same bank.
